_note: NOTAMs read for a pilot, the engine's notam_read (engine/crates/weather/src/notam_read): each in the form FAA Order JO 7930.2's examples give it (Appendix A; the paragraph in each case's about), with Oshkosh's places and times. Each title names the thing its subject's words say (the words after the keyword), null where they name none. The words are worked by hand from the order: its contractions written out (JO 7340.2, TBL 3-3-1), feet MSL unless AGL is stated (4-2-1), times UTC (3-3-2). engine/facade/tests/notam_read.rs asks the engine each case.
